ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure is triangle FGH, vertex F is above, G is at the lower left, H is at the lower right. The base GH is labeled as 12. Angle F is labeled as 60°, angle G is labeled as 60°. Reasoning: The sum of the interior angles of a triangle is 180°, given angle F = 60° and angle G = 60°, so angle H = 180° - 60° - 60° = 60°. All three angles are 60°, therefore triangle FGH is an equilateral triangle. The three sides of an equilateral triangle are equal, so FH = GH = 12.

Therefore all three sides are equal, and FH equals the labeled side GH, giving FH = 12.
